steps: Pressure cook the soaked rajma and the potato for 6 to 7 whistles until very soft, then drain.
Peel the potato and mash it with the rajma until smooth, with no whole beans left.
Mix in the crumbled bread, crushed cumin and chopped coriander and shape into small flat tikkis.
Cook the tikkis in the oil on a flat pan on medium-low heat, 3 to 4 minutes a side, until golden.
For the soup, pressure cook the chopped beetroot and carrot with 150 ml water for 3 to 4 whistles.
Blend the vegetables with their water until smooth; strain it if your child likes it thin.
Warm the soup with a pinch of cumin and serve it lukewarm next to the tikkis.
note: Rajma must be cooked very soft and mashed fully for a toddler; rinsed tinned rajma saves the soak. No salt, chilli or amchur in either part.
